thread:
maya: FYI: HF -> Redwood conversion for archai-3b-chat failing CI, looks like config.json mismatches (kv heads + rope_scaling + sliding_window)
jordan: logs? paste error please
maya: err snippet:
```
ERROR: kv cache shape mismatch: expected (n_kv=64, head_dim=64) got (n_kv=32, head_dim=64)
config: "num_key_value_heads": 32, model.hparams.attn_heads: 64
```
zara: ugh, HF sometimes encodes grouped kv heads with num_key_value_heads, while runtime expects absolute kv head count. also rope_scaling formats differ (:facepalm:)
leo: also saw sliding_window: true + max_position_embeddings=2048 but tokenizer.model_max_length=1024 -> prefix/KV index misalign -> can throw position index OOB
convert-bot: conversion-check: missing mapping for key "rope_scaling" (found "alpha"), suggested normalize to "scale".
maya: Proposed fixes in conversion script:
- derive kv_heads = cfg.get('num_key_value_heads') OR compute from attn_heads/grouping
- normalize rope_scaling entries (alpha -> scale, interp -> method)
- set max_position_embeddings = max(cfg.max_position_embeddings, tokenizer.model_max_length) to avoid OOB
- only enable sliding_window if tokenizer supports stride and model supports prefix caching
jordan: please add small unit tests that simulate HF configs with grouped heads + rope alpha variant
maya: will open PR with tests + a smoke-checker that instantiates model, runs a short gen, and asserts kv cache shapes
zara: saw a canary failure earlier: `RuntimeError: position index out of range` when sliding_window true and max_pos < seq_len — reproducible with seq_len=1200 and model.max_pos=1024
leo: short-term workaround: override converted config post-conversion, e.g. 
`{"num_key_value_heads":64, "max_position_embeddings":4096, "rope_scaling": {"scale": 0.5}}`
jordan: :thumbsup: also add an entry to conversion.log with before/after mapping so we can audit model rollouts
maya: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-infra/pull/987 (WIP). I'll add canary plan once CI green
convert-bot: conversion-check summary for archai-3b-chat: warnings=1 (rope_scaling variant), criticals=0, kv-heads-derived=64, rope-normalized=true
zara: we'll run full evals post-canary, esp quantized INT8 — kv/head mismatches can silently change generation quality
leo: I'll seed a quick eval job, put prompts in ./evals/rope-regression.yaml and run on dedicated GPU pool
jordan: good catch all, thx. anyone want to include a couple targeted prompts that expose rotary scaling issues?
leo: adding 6 short prompts now, will link results in thread
maya: thanks — tracking this on #model-onboarding board and adding a conversion smoke test to CI. :white_check_mark:
